crm_notes:
Prospect: large audiovisual archive (news footage + scanned print). Primary problem: search relevance for long, noisy OCR transcripts + entity/time filtering. POC ask: show cost/latency tradeoffs for embeddings + reranking at scale.

Indexing / scale notes:
- Current source corpus ~120M paragraphs (pre-clean). After sentence-chunk heuristic + semantic join reduction expect ~10-15M indexable segments.
- Want incremental ingestion: daily 200k new segments, need cold/hot shard strategy.
- Vector DB choices discussed: in-house FAISS vs Milvus vs managed (Pinecone). Prefers vendor-managed for maintenance but must validate residency.

Chunking strategy discussion (from tech call):
- Hybrid chunking: token-limited windows (max 512 tokens) with 20% overlap for context preservation.
- Semantic join pass: merge adjacent short segments when embedding similarity > 0.82 to avoid fragmentation for long paragraphs.
- Store original doc offsets and timecodes for media so reranker can surface exact clip.
- Experimentation plan: A/B three chunk sizes (256, 512, adaptive semantic) and measure recall@10 vs token cost.

Reranker tuning (notes / priorities):
- Baseline: bi-encoder retrieval (dense) -> cross-encoder rerank top-k (k=50) for precision. Concern: cross-encoder latency and cost.
- Proposed optimization: use distilled cross-encoder for k=20; reserve full cross-encoder only for high-confidence triggers (paid accounts, legal search).
- Consider lightweight neural reranker + lexical scoring hybrid (BM25 + dot-product) to prefilter to k=100 quickly.
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms, p90 < 350ms for end-to-end (embed lookup + rerank). Currently our test cross-encoder gives p90 ~ 520ms on same infra -> too slow.
- Cost target: goal ~$0.0015 - $0.003 per user query at scale (includes vector lookup + reranker compute amortized). Need Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching / quantization.

Operational notes / constraints:
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs ingestion into SIEM, KMS-managed keys, and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Network: private VPC peering preferred; will evaluate Redwood Private appliance for air-gapped archival subsets.
- SLA needs: 99.9% uptime for search endpoints, predictable throughput during nightly batch reindex windows.

Quotes & direct snippets:
- "We need near-perfect relevance on decades of OCR; users must find the clip and timestamp, not just the doc." — Head of Search Product
- "Willing to trade cost for latency up to a point; can't have >300ms for critical enterprise search flows." — CTO

POC plan (agreed):
- 30-day POC, scope: ingest 10M preprocessed segments, run 3 chunking strategies, 2 reranker configs (distilled CE, full CE), measure recall/latency/cost.
- Benchmarks to deliver: recall@10/50, p50/p90 latency, cost per 1k queries, operational metrics (indexing throughput, daily ingestion).
- Deliverables: POC report + recommended production architecture (Dedicated vs Private), recommended model/quantization profiles, fallback routing policy doc.

Next steps (short):
- Jordan to schedule 90-min benchmark session w/ infra + search team (target week of 2026-03-15).
- Maya to provision sample dataset upload link and provide ingestion checklist.
